name.ja: BB戦士306 呂布(リョフ)トールギス

description.ja: 天下にその名を轟かせる一騎当千の豪将“呂布トールギス”と稀代の名馬“赤兎馬（せきとば）”、超古代兵器“天玉鎧（てんぎょくがい）”、世界を統べる王の証“玉璽（ぎょくじ）”がセットになって遂に登場！ 呂布トールギスの巨体（劉備ガンダムとの対比約125%）を再現 マスク部はクリアパーツ、兜の飾りは紫色のメッキパーツで再現 愛用の巨大武器“破塵戟”が付属 赤兎馬は戦馬形態から戦輪形態へ変形、呂布トールギスや別売りの他武将を搭載可能 天玉鎧はパーツの組み換えでいろいろな形態に変形、劉備ガンダム（別売り）、曹操ガンダム（別売り）、孫権ガンダム（別売り）との連動遊びが可能 物語の鍵となる重要アイテム“玉璽（ぎょくじ）”が付属
description.en: A set of the powerful general "Ryob Tallgeese " whose name is known throughout the world, the rare famous horse " Red Hare ", the super ancient weapon " Tengyokugai ", and the seal of the king who rules the world " Gyokuji " is finally here! Reproduces the huge body of Lu Bu Tallgeese (approximately 125% compared to Liu Bei Gundam) The mask part is reproduced with clear parts and the decoration of the helmet is reproduced with purple plated parts The favorite huge weapon " Hajingeki " is included The Red Hare transforms from war horse form to war ring form, and can be equipped with Lu Bu Tallgeese and other military commanders (sold separately) The Heavenly Jewel Armor can be transformed into various forms by rearranging its parts, and can be used in conjunction with Liu Bei Gundam (sold separately), Cao Cao Gundam (sold separately), and Sun Quan Gundam (sold separately).An important item " Gyokuji" that is the key to the story is included.
